goal: Implement the complete UI-independent Decompose component graph and MVIKotlin Stores for SproutPace SCREEN-001 through SCREEN-016 and FLOW-001 through FLOW-012. Use a separate shared:component module plus shared:root assembly module, public immutable component models/callbacks/outputs, retained Stores for every UI-visible Value<Model>, component-owned Preview implementations for every Compose-rendered contract, serializable navigation configs, lifecycle/back handling, manual factories, and centralized root component tests. Implement all approved screen/flow states so later UI/platform/data integrations plug into stable Manager interfaces; do not edit Compose UI, platform code, data implementations, settings.gradle, or version catalog.
acceptanceCriteria: Every production Compose-rendered screen contract has a sibling component-owned Preview implementation; navigation-only exclusions are documented.
Every UI-visible production Value<Model> is mapped from a retained MVIKotlin Store; production MutableValue and direct repository/data access are absent.
Stores use Manager Kotlin Result boundaries, cancellation-aware fold handling, pure reducers, deterministic initialization, lifecycle cleanup, and debug-only logging wiring.
Root owns stable bottom navigation, stacks/slots/panels, deep-link outputs, duplicate-click safety, state restoration, and compact/expanded navigation contracts.
Models carry stable IDs/resource keys rather than resolved localized strings, and no locale selector/state is introduced.
Centralized deterministic tests cover public callbacks/models, navigation, lifecycle/resume/back, retention/restoration, Store result branches, and the listed AC behaviors.
No Compose rendering, native platform API, SQL driver, network transport, Firebase, or Yandex SDK code is added.
